programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: In 1492, Europe is dwarfed in power by the civilizations of China, India, the Ottomans of the Middle East and even the empires of Africa; the modern nation-state, capitalism, Christianity and new technologies combine to catapult Portugal.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither villain nor visionary, Christopher Columbus is an extremely learned and devout man; he embarks on his enterprise of the Indies for gold, glory and gospel; he dies unaware that he has initiated arguably the most important event in history.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Within a generation, the Spanish sweep across the Caribbean Sea and the surrounding regions; conquering and annihilating native peoples; establishing the patterns of conquest that they repeat across the Americas for nearly a century.
programme.sub-title: Stepping Stones-The Conquest of the Caribbean

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: In the conquest of Mexico, two empires collide; two mighty figures clash; Hernan Cortes leads a renegade Spanish expedition to the coast of Mexico; he exploits divisions among the various Indian tribes; capturing Montezuma in his own palace.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: Revealing the truths of ancient North America, which include pyramids, state-of-the-art highways and productive innovators; how the societies seemed destined to remain a mystery due to European conquerors and no written records.
programme.sub-title: The Unknown Story of Ancient North America

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: DNA evidence pointing to Asia as the origin of all human migration to North America; migration passages across the Bering Strait; ancient habitation sites across the continent; why scientists cannot yet agree on the ages of the sites.
programme.sub-title: The First Human Migrations to the Americas

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: Exploring the very first American culture, which is identified by a specialized hunting tool called the Clovis point; how the Clovis populated the Americas from coast to coast; how some of the Clovis people evolved into the last Paleo-Indians.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: How Paleo-Indian culture began to diversify regionally; understanding why some groups developed a hunting and gathering culture, while others fished from temporary camps; what DNA research reveals about one ancient sedentary people.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: How the creative yet disparate peoples of North America developed innovations such as corn agriculture, permanent houses and religion about 5,000 years ago; exploring the only innovation common to these many different cultures.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: How a group of ancient people developed a planned community on more than 900 acres of land to accommodate 4,000 to 5,000 inhabitants; how the city of Poverty Point functioned for 1,000 years and included one of the world's oldest pyramids.
programme.sub-title: Poverty Point: North America's First City

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: Surveying what is known about medicine wheels, which are wagon-wheel type arrangements of stones on the ground that vary in their number of spokes and size; learning their functions and meaning, which almost certainly changed over time.
programme.sub-title: Medicine Wheels of the Great Plains

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America

programme.sub-title: Adena Culture and the Early Woodlands Period

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America

programme.desc: Exploring the very first American culture, which is identified by a specialized hunting tool called the Clovis point; how the Clovis populated the Americas from coast to coast; how some of the Clovis people evolved into the last Paleo-Indians.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: How Paleo-Indian culture began to diversify regionally; understanding why some groups developed a hunting and gathering culture, while others fished from temporary camps; what DNA research reveals about one ancient sedentary people.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: How the creative yet disparate peoples of North America developed innovations such as corn agriculture, permanent houses and religion about 5,000 years ago; exploring the only innovation common to these many different cultures.

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: How a group of ancient people developed a planned community on more than 900 acres of land to accommodate 4,000 to 5,000 inhabitants; how the city of Poverty Point functioned for 1,000 years and included one of the world's oldest pyramids.
programme.sub-title: Poverty Point: North America's First City

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: Surveying what is known about medicine wheels, which are wagon-wheel type arrangements of stones on the ground that vary in their number of spokes and size; learning their functions and meaning, which almost certainly changed over time.
programme.sub-title: Medicine Wheels of the Great Plains

programme.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America
programme.desc: The evolution of the continent's first coherent civilizations in Ohio about 3,000 years ago; studying the Adena, the first ancient American culture with a wide-ranging influence; the Adena's conical burial mounds and shared concept of an afterlife.
programme.sub-title: Adena Culture and the Early Woodlands Period

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: The commonly held views of Native Americans and the realities of a tapestry of vibrant cultures; Cobb explains the pitfalls that occur when history does not provide this crucial viewpoint; the mistake of consigning Native Americans to the past.
programme.sub-title: Native America: A Story of Survival

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: The misleading dichotomy of Old World and New World impacts perceptions of Native Americans; the Columbian Exchange is the crux behind the creation of new worlds for all; shaping everything from the fauna and flora to the cuisines of the world.
programme.sub-title: The Columbian Exchange: New Worlds for All

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: The cultures that exist before the Spanish Invasion; the struggle for power through Hernando de Soto's entrada through the Southeast; the Pueblo War for Independence in the Southwest; the Native American worlds born in the aftermath of these events.
programme.sub-title: The Native South and Southwest in the 1600s

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: How connections are forged between Native Americans and newcomers as they incorporate each other into their worlds; examples across the Northeastern Woodlands down to Werowocomoco; how the search for common ground begins at first contact.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: Once Europeans arrive, the Native peoples of the Northeast want to maintain their autonomy; the strategies and experiences of the Wendat and Iroquois; Native Americans transform the European colonial project while preserving a measured separatism.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: An exploration of the Iroquois Confederacy and the Lenape people; Native Americans keep or lose their lands through treaties and negotiations; the repercussions of these conflicts sometimes go beyond relocation; enslavement or near annihilation.

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: The French and Indian War are portrayed in history as a turning point for Native nations in the East; for some, it serves as a victory, for others, a defeat; a changed storyline; the perspectives of Native people who experience the era differently.
programme.sub-title: The Seven Years' War in Indian Country

programme.title: Native Peoples of North America
programme.desc: The Native Americans experience the American Revolution as allies, as participants in their own civil wars and as neutral parties; for many, the resolution of the American Revolution holds little meaning; the rule of the colonists or the Crown.
programme.sub-title: The American Revolution through Native Eyes

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: In 1492, Europe is dwarfed in power by the civilizations of China, India, the Ottomans of the Middle East and even the empires of Africa; the modern nation-state, capitalism, Christianity and new technologies combine to catapult Portugal.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Neither villain nor visionary, Christopher Columbus is an extremely learned and devout man; he embarks on his enterprise of the Indies for gold, glory and gospel; he dies unaware that he has initiated arguably the most important event in history.

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: Within a generation, the Spanish sweep across the Caribbean Sea and the surrounding regions; conquering and annihilating native peoples; establishing the patterns of conquest that they repeat across the Americas for nearly a century.
programme.sub-title: Stepping Stones-The Conquest of the Caribbean

programme.title: Conquest of the Americas
programme.desc: In the conquest of Mexico, two empires collide; two mighty figures clash; Hernan Cortes leads a renegade Spanish expedition to the coast of Mexico; he exploits divisions among the various Indian tribes; capturing Montezuma in his own palace.

programme.title: America's Founding Fathers
programme.desc: Explaining the importance of getting a well-rounded understanding of the Founders; Professor Guelzo explores Washington's fears about post-Revolutionary America; Washington's concerns about how people could administer their own affairs.

programme.title: America's Founding Fathers
programme.desc: Before the ratification of the Constitution, there are presidents of the Congress created by the Articles of Confederation; the failures of one president, Thomas Mifflin, offer a window into the problems facing the United States of America in 1783.

programme.title: America's Founding Fathers
programme.desc: Money issues abound in the new United States; why the abundance of land is a problem; what compels states to print their own paper money; how Robert Morris attempts to restore the links between commerce, agriculture and government finances.

programme.title: America's Founding Fathers
programme.desc: Exploring the many roles Benjamin Franklin plays in the formative years of the republic; this includes his part as an independent printer, a public "gentleman", a nobleman of nature and a tradesman cynical of the wealthy and powerful.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.desc: Exploring The French and Indian War of the mid-1700s, which is one of the formative conflicts in American military history; focusing on the experiences of Lt. Col. George Washington, a young colonial officer fighting for the British.

programme.title: American Military History: From Colonials to Counterinsurgents
programme.desc: When the colonies begin their struggle for independence, they choose George Washington to lead the army; Washington's defense of Boston; his defeat trying to hold New York City; contrasting British and American objectives in the Revolutionary War.

programme.title: Unfriended: Dark Web
programme.desc: After finding a laptop, a young man goes online to play a game with five of his good friends. He shows them a mysterious folder that plays disturbing videos of people who appear to be in danger. They then receive an anonymous message that tells them they will all die if they disconnect or call the police. The planned night of fun quickly turns deadly as each user becomes the target of something sinister while the others watch helplessly in terror.

programme.title: Ma
programme.desc: A lonely middle-aged woman befriends some teenagers and decides to let them party in the basement of her home. But there are some house rules: One of the kids has to stay sober, don't curse, and never go upstairs. They must also refer to her as Ma. But as Ma's hospitality starts to curdle into obsession, what began as a teenage dream turns into a terrorizing nightmare, and Ma's place goes from the best place in town to the worst place on Earth.

programme.title: Seven in Heaven
programme.desc: A 16-year-old discovers all of his fears are true.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder (Liam Neeson), leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The People Under the Stairs
programme.desc: When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: "Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: The Hunted
programme.desc: New York executive Paul Racine (Christopher Lambert) is on a business trip in Japan when he meets the stunning, enigmatic Kirina (Joan Chen). They spend the night together in her hotel room, and Racine returns the next day to retrieve his forgotten keys. But once he's there, he witnesses Kirina's assassination by Kinjo (John Lone), the leader of a ninja cult. Realizing that Racine has seen everything, Kinjo will do everything in his power to end the executive's life.

programme.title: Session 9
programme.desc: A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing ... abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors...

programme.title: The Signal
programme.desc: A surprise awaits three college students (Brenton Thwaites, Beau Knapp, Olivia Cooke) who think they have tracked a rival computer hacker to a shed in the Nevada desert.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notices curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parents (James Brolin) is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett (John Marley), is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren (Kathleen Lloyd), are endangered.

programme.title: You'll Like My Mother
programme.desc: When her husband is killed in Vietnam, Francesca Kinsolving (Patty Duke) finds herself pregnant and alone. She resolves to visit her in-laws in Minnesota, believing, based on her late husband's assurances, that she'll be welcomed there. Instead, she finds Mrs. Kinsolving (Rosemary Murphy) a dreadful curmudgeon who won't even admit that her son married. Shaken but not scared off, Francesca sticks around and discovers she may be entitled to the family fortune.

programme.title: The Midnight Man
programme.desc: A paroled ex-police detective (Burt Lancaster) works as campus night watchman and solves a coed's murder.

programme.title: Frenzy
programme.desc: London is held in the grip of a serial killer whose modus operandi is to murder his victims by strangling them with a necktie. When short-tempered ex-Royal Air Force officer Richard Blaney (Jon Finch) discovers his ex-wife (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) murdered, Blaney becomes a suspect. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster), however Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.title: El hombre que perdió el tren
programme.desc: Un hombre pierde su boleto de tren a Madrid y decide visitar la catedral de Alcona, donde es confundido con un músico.

programme.title: Águilas de acero
programme.desc: Pilotos de la Fuerza Aérea muestran algunas de sus proezas, además de emocionantes aventuras en combate.

programme.title: No se Mande Profe
programme.desc: Un profesor de literatura ama a una alumna y para complacerla se disfraza como los personajes que la joven admira.

programme.title: Para servir a usted
programme.desc: Un mesero es invitado a una fiesta importante donde conoce a una prostituta y se enamora desesperadamente de ella.

programme.title: Al diablo las mujeres
programme.desc: Una joven es nombrada presidenta municipal y exige encarcelar a sus primos, que son obligados a barrer las calles.

programme.title: Se los chupó la bruja
programme.desc: Dos inventores que deben catorce meses de renta quedan en la calle, pero su suerte parece cambiar cuando reciben una herencia. Lo que no saben es que la mansión que les han legado está embrujada.

programme.desc: Unos bandidos obligan a una cajera a cambiarles billetes falsos por verdaderos, pero dos mozos del barco los descubren.

programme.title: Valentina
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes enamorados lamentan la lentitud con que llegan sus fortunas y luego no saben cómo enfrentar los giros de la vida.

programme.title: Una canción a la Virgen
programme.desc: Una mujer y su hija van a una basílica a pedir que su esposo regrese con ellas y la Virgen les concede el milagro.

programme.title: Loquita de amor
programme.desc: Un soldado español regresa a su pueblo después de la I Guerra Mundial y recuerda su vida y amores anteriores.

programme.title: Mis hijos
programme.desc: Veinte años de haber sufrido un accidente, una mujer recupera la memoria e intenta desesperadamente encontrar a sus tres hijos.

programme.title: La sin ventura
programme.desc: Margarita es una sofisticada vedette que, en su camino al éxito, mantiene varios romances. Cansada de esa vida, decide irse a Betania para empezar una nueva vida y así guardar el secreto de su oscuro pasado.

programme.title: Vestidas y alborotadas
programme.desc: Dos gemelas llegan a México y rápidamente encuentran novio, pero estos pobres hombres las confunden continuamente.

programme.title: La mafia amarilla
programme.desc: Una pandilla china asesina a un hombre y Blue Demon, con la ayuda de su amigo, tiene que encontrar al culpable.

programme.title: La doncella de piedra
programme.desc: Una joven vuelve a Venezuela tras estudiar en Estados Unidos y ayuda a una tribu que la cree la doncella de una leyenda.

programme.title: El Señor Tormenta

programme.title: El hacha diabólica

programme.desc: Un hombre agonizante pide a su esposa que jamás revele, que uno de sus hijos es en verdad el hijo bastardo del patrón.

programme.title: Art of Ward
programme.desc: The Art of Ward, hosted by boxing Hall of Famer Andre Ward, explores the fight game from the inside out.

programme.title: The Frozen Ghost
programme.desc: When famous radio hypnotist Alex Gregor (Lon Chaney Jr.) accidentally causes the death of an audience member during a broadcast, his guilt leads him to break off his engagement to Maura Daniel (Evelyn Ankers) and take a job at a wax museum. Jealousy over the attention paid to his new co-worker causes mentally unbalanced sculptor Rudi Poldan (Martin Kosleck) to lash out at museum owner Valerie Monet (Tala Birell) and her niece Nina (Elena Verdugo) in a horrifying fashion.

programme.title: The Funhouse
programme.desc: Rebellious teen Amy (Elizabeth Berridge) defies her parents by going to a trashy carnival that has pulled into town. In tow are her boyfriend, Buzz (Cooper Huckabee), and their friends Liz (Largo Woodruff) and Richie (Miles Chapin). Thinking it would be fun to spend the night in the campy Funhouse horror ride, the teens witness a murder by a deformed worker wearing a mask. Locked in, Amy and her friends must evade the murderous carnival workers and escape before it leaves town the next day.

programme.title: The Ghost of Frankenstein
programme.desc: Shepherd Ygor (Bela Lugosi) rescues the monster (Lon Chaney) from a sulfur pit and brings him to Dr. Frankenstein's other son (Cedric Hardwicke).

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: House of Dracula
programme.desc: This monster movie focuses on the iconic vampire, Count Dracula (John Carradine), and Lawrence Talbot (Lon Chaney), better known as the Wolf Man. Both beings of the night are tired of their supernatural afflictions, so they seek out Dr. Franz Edelmann (Onslow Stevens) for cures for their respective curses. While trying to aid the imposing creatures, Edelmann himself develops a transformative condition, adding to the many ghouls lurking around the foreboding landscape.

programme.title: House of Frankenstein
programme.desc: After escaping from prison, the evil Dr. Niemann (Boris Karloff) and his hunchbacked assistant, Daniel (J. Carrol Naish), plot their revenge against those who imprisoned them. For this, they recruit the powerful Wolf Man (Lon Chaney), Frankenstein's monster (Glenn Strange) and even Dracula himself (John Carradine). Niemann pursues those who wrong him, sending each monster out to do his dirty work. But his control on the monsters is weak at best and may prove to be his downfall.

programme.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
programme.desc: While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

programme.title: The Invisible Man Returns
programme.desc: Wrongly accused of murdering his brother, Geoffrey Radcliffe (Vincent Price) is found guilty and sentenced to die. But when sympathetic Dr. Griffin (John Sutton) injects him with a serum that renders him invisible, Radcliffe is able to escape and search for the real culprit. With Inspector Sampson (Cecil Kellaway) of Scotland Yard hot on his trail, Radcliffe begins to suspect that a recent hire in his family's mining company might have the answers he seeks.

programme.title: The Invisible Man
programme.desc: While researching a new drug, Dr. Jack Griffin (Claude Rains) stumbles on a potion that can make him invisible. When he reveals his new ability to his old mentor (Henry Travers) and his fiancée (Gloria Stuart), it's clear that a side effect of the potion is insanity. Jack goes on a violent rampage, and the police struggle to hunt him down, unable to see their target, while his mentor and his former partner (William Harrigan) desperately try to devise a plan to capture him.

programme.title: The Invisible Man's Revenge
programme.desc: A criminal (Jon Hall) haunts his enemies' mansion after a mad scientist (John Carradine) makes him invisible.

programme.title: The Invisible Woman

programme.title: Island of Lost Souls
programme.desc: In this adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel "The Island of Doctor Moreau," Edward Parker (Richard Arlen) is shipwrecked on a remote island presided over by the mysterious Dr. Moreau (Charles Laughton). Edward discovers his host is conducting genetic experiments, and presiding over a race of half-human, half-animal hybrids, including the alluring Panther Woman and the sage Sayer of the Law (Bela Lugosi). The island has become its own society, with Moreau as its god.

programme.title: It Came From Outer Space
programme.desc: While looking through his telescope one night, John Putnam (Richard Carlson) sees what at first appears to be a meteor shower -- but it is actually a crash-landing alien spaceship! After investigating the crater from the impact, John informs the town sheriff (Charles Drake), and receives nothing but ridicule. Even his fiancée, Ellen (Barbara Rush), is skeptical. All that changes when the townsfolk start disappearing, and are replaced by eerie alien duplicates.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: A team of British archaeologists led by Sir Joseph Whemple (Arthur Byron) discover the mummified remains of the ancient Egyptian prince Imhotep (Boris Karloff), along with the legendary scroll of Thoth. When one of the archaeologists recites the scroll aloud, Imhotep returns to life, but escapes. Several years later, Imhotep has taken on the guise of a wealthy man, as he searches Egypt for his lost love, who he believes has been reincarnated as the lovely Helen Grosvenor (Zita Johann).

programme.title: The Mummy's Hand
programme.desc: In Cairo, archaeologist Steve Banning (Dick Foran) unearths a vase that he believes could lead him to the ancient tomb of Princess Ananka. Unknown to Steve, his colleague, Professor Andoheb (George Zucco), is also the High Priest of Karnac who holds the secrets of Karas, a mummy who guards Ananka's tomb. Upon receiving funds from magician Solvani (Cecil Kellaway) and his daughter, Marta (Peggy Moran), Steve and the Solvanis embark on an expedition to the grave site, where Karas awaits.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: The European Poker Tour celebrates its 20th anniversary in Barcelona, the city where it all began. Nearly 2,000 players compete in the Main Event for a €1.5m first prize. EPT legends return to the tables and reigning champ Simon Wiciak looks to defend his title.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Day 2 of the European Poker Tour Main Event continues, with PSPC champion Ramon Colillas, the USA's Rania Nasreddine and Canada's Griffin Benger among the players hoping to survive the session and stay in contention for the title, trophy and €1.5m top prize.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: They're on the bubble in the European Poker Tour Main Event. The next six players to be eliminated will leave with nothing. The rest will be guaranteed a slice of the €9.5m prize pool. Can YouTube star Wolfgang Poker and Canadian pro Griffin Benger make it into the money?

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: At the European Poker Tour's 20th anniversary celebrations, there's a throwback vibe in the Main Event. A player calling himself 'The Eliminator' is holding court at the feature table. Expect banter and bluffs, as this old school character competes for the €1.5m first prize.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Survival is the name of the game, with just over 100 players remaining in the European Poker Tour Main Event. Most of the €9.5m prize pool is still up for grabs, and reigning champ Simon Wiciak and Monte-Carlo finalist Rania Nasreddine can both make EPT history.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: There's €1.5m for the winner of this special anniversary edition of the European Poker Tour. As Day 4 of the Main Event continues, the USA's Rania Nasreddine is put through the wringer and a new generation of poker talent starts to make its mark.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Only 40 players remain in the European Poker Tour Main Event, including reigning champion Simon Wiciak. Can the French pro go back-to-back? The competition is tough: chip leader Stephen Song and Monte-Carlo finalist Rania Nasreddine are also eyeing the €1.5m top prize.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: In the late stages of this European Poker Tour Main Event, mistakes are starting to creep in. But there's no margin for error, with millions still on the line. Among the final 23 are American pro Stephen Song and former EPT finalist Rania Nasreddine.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: All eyes are on the USA's Rania Nasreddine, as she tries to make back-to-back European Poker Tour final tables. Brazilian pro Fabiano Kovalski is another previous EPT finalist looking for a second chance at victory. The top prize in this tournament is €1.5m.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Nine remain in the Main Event. Two are on course to make history. One will be crowned champion and earn $1.5m. The USA's Stephen Song and Rania Nasreddine are among the players battling chip leader Fabiano Kovalski for supremacy.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: It's the final table of the Main Event and the conclusion of the European Poker Tour's 20th anniversary celebrations. Three American players, including Rania Nasreddine, are among the final six. Who will lift the trophy and earn the first prize of $1.5m?

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Super High Roller (SHR)-The €100,000 Super High Roller reaches its climactic finale with six elite players vying for nearly €1.4 million. Leading the pack is 2015 Monte Carlo Main Event champion Adrian Mateos, facing off against poker heavyweights Mikita Badziakouski, László Bujtas, and Marius Gierse, plus wildcards Kent Staahle and Mikalai Vaskaboinikau. With life-changing money on the line, who will claim the prestigious title?

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 1 (ME1)-After a three-year hiatus, the prestigious EPT Monte Carlo €5,000 Main Event returns in spectacular fashion. Day 2 brings together poker's biggest names, including high-stakes specialist Patrik Antonius, World Champion Koray Aldemir, Italian ace Mustapha Kanit, and trailblazing two-time EPT champion Victoria Coren-Mitchell. The battle for poker immortality begins.

programme.title: The Comeback with Craig Carton
programme.desc: Craig Carton sits down with those who have experienced the highs and lows of gambling addiction to amplify their stories, break down the stigma surrounding gambling disorder, raise awareness of support resources for individuals and their families, and show that recovery is possible.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 2 (ME2)-Tension mounts as the money bubble approaches in Monte Carlo's Main Event. With 159 players set to cash for at least €8,690, every decision matters. EPT legends Patrik Antonius and Davidi Kitai command the feature table while 2019 PSPC champion Ramon Colillas holds the chip lead. Who will survive the bubble and who will go home empty-handed?

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 3 (ME3)-The money bubble has burst, but for seasoned pro Ole Schemion-who has earned over $5 million in Monte Carlo alone-a minimum cash isn't enough. He faces a formidable challenge from French star Gaëlle Baumann and online legend Jussi Nevanlinna at the feature table. With real money now guaranteed, the gloves come off.

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 4 (ME4)-PSPC champion Ramon Colillas surges into the top five as just 40 players remain in the EPT Monte Carlo Main Event. Day 3 intensifies as competitors battle to reach the final two tables. With the finish line in sight, who has what it takes to keep their championship dreams alive?

programme.title: European Poker Tour
programme.desc: Main Event Episode 5 (ME5)-The field narrows to just 16 survivors, including EPT Dublin champion Niall Farrell and PSPC winner Ramon Colillas. With over €41,000 already locked up, the stakes couldn't be higher as players fight for their place at the final table of nine. Every hand could be the difference between glory and heartbreak.

Edward is a vampire whose family does not drink blood, and Bella, far from being frightened, enters into a dangerous romance with her immortal soulmate.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Eclipse
programme.desc: Danger once again surrounds Bella, as a string of mysterious killings terrorizes Seattle and a malicious vampire continues her infernal quest for revenge. Amid the tumult, Bella must choose between her love for Edward and her friendship with Jacob, knowing that her decision may ignite the long-simmering feud between vampire and werewolf.

programme.title: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn Part 1
programme.desc: At last, Bella and Edward are getting married. When Jacob finds out that Bella wants to spend her honeymoon as a human, he is horrified, for Edward's passion could accidentally kill her. Bella does indeed survive her honeymoon, but a new complication arises when she discovers that she's pregnant, and the child is growing at an alarming rate. The pregnancy sets the wolves against Bella and Edward, but Jacob vows to protect his friend.

programme.desc: Lies, Lies, and More Lies. This was the prosecution's theme in bringing in neighbors of Susan Wright to testify against her. Her defense wanted to present Wright as innocent housewife and stay-at-home mom of two who was abused and tormented by her husband.

programme.title: The Blue Eyed Butcher Case

programme.title: The Blue Eyed Butcher Case

programme.title: The Blue Eyed Butcher Case
programme.desc: Jurors heard directly from Susan Wright herself. She took the stand to try to prove to them that she was a victim of domestic abuse in her marriage to Jeff and only killed him in a fight to save her life. The defendant went on to Walk the jury through the beginning of her relationship with Jeff. According to her, what began as a charming sequence of a Love attraction slowly evolved into a troubling marriage filled with torment and domestic violence.
programme.sub-title: From A Love Connection To Domestic Abuse

programme.title: The Blue Eyed Butcher Case
programme.desc: On the very day of Jeff Wright's Birthday, his wife took the stand in her own murder trial. In her emotional testimony, Susan told jurors that she was basically trapped in her tormenting marriage. As a stay-at-home mom of two young children she didn't have her own money and was constantly beaten up by Jeff every time he got mad. According to his wife, Jeff was a child abuser, drug addict and a wife beater, who regularly cheated on Susan and vacationed to remote places without her.

programme.title: The Blue Eyed Butcher Case
programme.desc: I didn't want to die. That's how Susan Wright emotionally recalled to the jury the alleged attack by her husband, Jeff. This was just minutes before she countered his knife attack and began stabbing him to death. Susan claimed, He was still alive after she stabbed Jeff numerous times throughout his body. She emotionally recalled to jurors that she was so scared that he was still alive even after she dumped his body in the makeshift grave in the backyard.

programme.title: The Blue Eyed Butcher Case
programme.desc: More teary-eyed testimony continued with the defendant on the stand. Susan Wright gave her side of the story on how her husband, Jeff, came at her with a knife after he allegedly raped her. She wrestled the knife away from him and used to stab him multiple times while he was tied to the bed. Wright told jurors: I still hadn't grasped everything that happened in that room. Next, the defendant faced a probing cross-examination.

programme.title: Accomplice to Murder, With Vinnie Politan
programme.desc: Investigators compared the gruesome scene of Earl and Terry Robertson's death to that of the Charles Manson murders; how the quiet and mild-mannered Meredith Moon became an accomplice to one of South Carolina's most horrific crimes.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: Ali Abulaban's lawyers had questions for the Detective-Sergeant who interviewed the defendant after his arrest. Police concluded that the long-standing abuse of his wife, Ana, ultimately led to her Murder along with that of her friend, Rayburn Barron. Narcissistic, impulsive, and theatrical. This was the demeanor of Ali Abulaban during his first interview with police, according to Detective Robert Hopper.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: Jurors heard the perspective of police on what happened to the defendant's wife Ana, and her friend, Rayburn Barron. According to this Detective Robert Hopper, Jealousy and anger had been on Ali Abulaban's mind before he committed these murders. But, according to Hopper, there was no suspicion of a psychological issue or a mental health disorder.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: The jury learned more about the gun used in the shooting deaths of his wife, Ana, and her friend, Rayburn Barron. They were shot at close range in her apartment. At the time of the fatal shootings, the defendant claimed he had a license to carry a Glock pistol. This would be the game used to Murder his wife and her friend in their apartment. On the stand was the firearm expert who examined the Glock 19 semi-automatic gun and ran some test-fires.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: The medical examiner who performed the autopsies on both Ana Abulaban and Rayburn Barron testified. Jurors saw Graphic photos from the examination as they learned more about the Gun Shot wounds. According to the medical examiner, both victims were shot at close range with the shooter being a few inches from their heads. Jurors would have to weigh those details when deciding whether Ali Abulaban shot them in a heat of Passion or as a murder plot carried out.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: Things got emotional for Ali Abulaban when the autopsy photos of his deceased wife, Ana, were displayed for the jury. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: Vampiro, guerrero de la noche
programme.desc: Un malvado científico construye una bomba para destruir el mundo y rapta a un luchador para que no impida sus planes.

programme.title: Los caifanes
programme.desc: Cinco hombres y una mujer deciden encontrar nuevas formas de diversión sin pensar en el efecto que tendrá en su vida.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un exnazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: Jalisco nunca pierde
programme.desc: Una joven muy bella arrolla con su caballo a un hombre, él la sigue para reclamarle pero al verla se enamora de ella.

programme.title: La dama de rojo
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su marido, "La dama de rojo" busca venganza y se involucra en la mafia de traficantes de piedras.

programme.title: La Dama de Rojo 2
programme.desc: La vida de una mujer valiente que tras la muerte de su marido quiere seguir con el negocio ilegal de las esmeraldas.

programme.title: La Venganza Del Chicano
programme.desc: Un hombre se ausenta por un tiempo y al regresar visita la hacienda donde sus padres laboran, mas se lleva una sorpresa.

programme.title: Ha llegado un Ángel
programme.desc: Una niña española y un niño mexicano están dispuestos a solucionar los problemas de todos.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: Acapulqueña
programme.desc: Un millonario decide montar un espectáculo con una mujer de Acapulco y dos hombres se enamoran de ella.

programme.title: La golondrina presumida
programme.desc: Una mujer de provincia rechaza a un ranchero por considerarlo de clase inferior. Él es un afortunado en los negocios, pero definitivamente un desafortunado en el amor.

programme.title: Nido de fieras
programme.desc: Al enterarse del asesinato de toda su familia, un joven regresa a su antiguo hogar y se gana la confianza de los responsables, sin que ellos sepan quién es.

programme.title: Buscando una sonrisa
programme.desc: Tras recibir la noticia de la muerte de su madre, un estudiante vaga por las calles hasta que encuentra a una amiga.

programme.title: Los amores de Juan Charrasqueado
programme.desc: Juan y María esperan un hijo, pero los hermanos de ella quieren separarlos. Sin embargo, fingen aceptar su relación para demostrar que él es un mujeriego.

programme.title: Águilas de acero
programme.desc: Pilotos de la Fuerza Aérea muestran algunas de sus proezas, además de emocionantes aventuras en combate.

programme.title: Dos esposas en mi cama
programme.desc: Carmen se pierde mientras viaja en globo. Cuando regresa a su casa, descubre que su esposo se ha casado porque la dio por muerta.

programme.title: El caballo bayo
programme.desc: Un jinete revolucionario y la mujer que lo ama y lo odia, buscan un tesoro de oro escondido en un lago.

programme.title: El regreso del carro rojo
programme.desc: Al salir Pablo de prisión, busca una llave que abre un resguardo donde está ubicada una carga de droga. Pablo y su amigo el Cachorro se vuelven mafiosos y venden la droga.

programme.title: La Noche del Ku Klux Klan
programme.desc: Varios inmigrantes ilegales transportan drogas sin saber que son perseguidos por siniestros miembros del Ku Klux Klan.

programme.title: Chicago, Pandillas Salvajes II
programme.desc: Un padre mexicano vive en Chicago y tiene que enfrentar el hecho de que sus tres hijos son miembros de pandillas.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: El corrido de María Pistolas
programme.desc: Un hombre finge estar del lado de los ricos para enterarse de sus planes, y así los revolucionarios venzan en un ataque.

programme.title: El oreja rajada
programme.desc: Dos niños angustiados y un campesino hacen todo lo posible por salvar a un purasangre. El ranchero Andrés quiere deshacerse de él, pero al final reconoce los méritos del caballo.

programme.title: El Centauro del Norte
programme.desc: Una villista se viste de taquera para liberar a un colega preso y es capturada por el capitán de las tropas federales.

programme.title: Santo en el Misterio de la Perla Negra
programme.desc: Unos diamantes son llevados América pegados en el casco de un buque y un enmascarado se encarga de investigar el caso.

programme.title: Alerta, alta tensión
programme.desc: Un inquebrantable agente del Gobierno resiste todo tipo de torturas de un malévolo grupo que intenta conseguir uranio para apoderarse del mundo entero.

programme.title: El pistolero del Diablo
programme.desc: Un hombre mata a su hijo, se vuelve alcohólico, pierde a su mujer, tiene alucionaciones y un pacto con el diablo.

programme.title: El 30-30
programme.desc: Con la intención de vengar la muerte de su padre, un hombre deambula sin rumbo de pueblo en pueblo hasta que se convierte en un jugador borracho pendenciero. Ahora lo único que puede transformar la vida de este fullero endurecido es el amor de la bella Gloria.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Mitch helps Special Olympics athletes raise money by organizing a beach competition featuring MTV personalities.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: C.J.'s mother arrives from Las Vegas with the mob hot on her trail in pursuit of a computer disk containing details about her gangster boyfriend's gambling profits.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Mitch (David Hasselhoff) and the Baywatch crew face tough rivals from Australia in a lifeguard competition.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Donna's (Donna D'Errico) appearance in Playboy causes problems for Mitch (David Hasselhoff); an earthquake traps a junior lifeguard.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Some of the Baywatch lifeguards try out for a new search and rescue unit after they help firefighters battle a blaze on a pier.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: A pollution problem in the bay hits home when Mitch becomes deathly ill during a practice swim for an Ironman competition.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Mitch has a busy day rescuing an injured swimmer and dealing with an editor who wants to feature him in her magazine; Stephanie and Tom's wedding gets moved up.

programme.title: Baywatch
programme.desc: Mitch and Neely join newlyweds Stephanie and Tom on a schooner for an adventure cruise that turns tragic when a hurricane hits.

programme.title: Baywatch
